source.text: Φοβηθῶμεν οὖν μήποτε καταλειπομένης ἐπαγγελίας εἰσελθεῖν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ δοκῇ τις ἐξ ὑμῶν ὑστερηκέναι·

records.literal_gloss: Let us fear therefore lest, being left a promise to enter into the rest of him, seem anyone of you to have fallen short;

en.L: Therefore let us fear lest, while a promise of entering into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rest is left [open], any of you should seem to have fallen short;
en.B: So, while the promise that we may enter {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rest is still open, let us be afraid that any one of you might be found to have missed it.
en.R: God's promise that we may enter {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rest is still open. So we should be afraid that any of you might fail to reach it.

es.L: Temamos, pues, que, quedando [en pie] una promesa de entrar en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reposo, alguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} parezca haberse quedado atrás;
es.B: Así pues, mientras sigue en pie la promesa de que podemos entrar en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reposo, tengamos temor de que alguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} resulte haberla perdido.
es.R: La promesa de Dios de que podemos entrar en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reposo sigue en pie. Por eso debemos tener temor de que alguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} no llegue a alcanzarla.

fr.L: Craignons donc que, tandis qu’une promesse d’entrer dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} repos demeure, l’un de vous ne paraisse être resté en arrière ;
fr.B: Ainsi, tant que la promesse d’entrer dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} repos reste valable, craignons qu’un seul d’entre vous ne se trouve l’avoir manquée.
fr.R: La promesse de Dieu, que nous pouvons entrer dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} repos, est toujours valable. Nous devons donc avoir peur que l’un de vous n’arrive pas à l’atteindre.

sw.L: Basi na tuogope, isije, wakati ahadi ya kuingia katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ingali imeachwa [wazi], yeyote kati yenu akaonekana kuwa amepungukiwa;
sw.B: Kwa hiyo, wakati ahadi ya kwamba tunaweza kuingia katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} bado iko wazi, na tuogope isije ikaonekana kwamba yeyote kati yenu amelikosa.
sw.R: Ahadi ya Mungu kwamba tunaweza kuingia katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} bado iko wazi. Kwa hiyo tunapaswa kuogopa kwamba yeyote kati yenu anaweza kushindwa kulifikia.

vi.L: Vậy, chúng ta hãy sợ kẻo, trong khi lời hứa được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn còn [để ngỏ], có ai trong anh chị em bị xem là đã bỏ lỡ;
vi.B: Vậy, trong khi lời hứa cho chúng ta được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn còn để ngỏ, chúng ta hãy sợ rằng có ai trong anh chị em bị thấy là đã bỏ lỡ lời hứa ấy.
vi.R: Lời Đức Chúa Trời hứa cho chúng ta được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn còn để ngỏ. Vì vậy chúng ta nên sợ kẻo có ai trong anh chị em không đến được nơi ấy.

ko.L: 그러므로 그분의 안식에 들어갈 약속이 [아직] 남아 있는 동안에, 여러분 가운데 누구라도 [거기에] 이르지 못한 것으로 보이지 않을까 두려워합시다.
ko.B: 그러므로 그분의 안식에 들어갈 수 있다는 약속이 아직 남아 있는 동안, 여러분 가운데 누구라도 그것을 놓친 사람으로 드러나지 않을까 두려워합시다.
ko.R: 하나님의 안식에 들어갈 수 있다는 약속은 아직 남아 있습니다. 그러므로 우리는 여러분 가운데 누구라도 그곳에 이르지 못할까 두려워해야 합니다.

decisions.choice: let us fear: a serious, healthy fear of missing what God offers
decisions.reason: The author means real fear, the kind that takes God's warning seriously (10:31; 12:28-29), not panic. The wilderness generation is the warning.

decisions.choice: while a promise is left: the promise was not used up when that generation failed
decisions.reason: καταλειπομένης means "being left behind", still remaining. The argument of 4:6-9 explains why the promise still stands.

decisions.choice: seem: be judged, be shown to have fallen short
alternatives: think (that he has come too late)
decisions.reason: δοκέω may mean "be found" or "seem": even the appearance of falling short is to be feared. It can also mean "think", so that the warning is against anyone thinking he has come too late for the promise. The first fits the stern tone of the passage better.

decisions.choice: fallen short: failed to reach, come too late
decisions.reason: The picture is of arriving too late, or falling behind on a journey and not reaching the goal.

decisions.choice: [open]
decisions.reason: Literal adds what "left" means here.

decisions.choice: missed it; fail to reach it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say plainly what falling short of the promise means.

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: As in chapter 3, every plural "you" addressed to the readers is a reader setting: ustedes (the default) or vosotros. "Reposo" stays the word for God's rest, as in 3:11.

decisions.choice: demeure (L); reste valable, est toujours valable (B, R)
decisions.reason: French "demeurer" already means "remain", so Literal needs no supplied word where the English brackets "[open]". A promise that still stands is "valable" in French; "ouverte" suits a door or a way more than a promise.

decisions.choice: "sợ" for "let us fear" at every level
decisions.reason: The fear is a serious, healthy fear of missing what God offers (m1). "Kính sợ" is reverence toward God, a different thing; plain "sợ" keeps the warning.

source.text: καὶ γάρ ἐσμεν εὐηγγελισμένοι καθάπερ κἀκεῖνοι, ἀλλ’ οὐκ ὠφέλησεν ὁ λόγος τῆς ἀκοῆς ἐκείνους, μὴ συγκεκερασμένους τῇ πίστει τοῖς ἀκούσασιν.

records.literal_gloss: And for we are having had good news announced just as also those; but not benefited the word of the hearing those, not having been joined together by the faith with the [ones] having heard.

en.L: For indeed we have had good news announced [to us], just as those also; but the word of hearing did not benefit those, since they were not joined together by faith with those who heard.
en.B: For we too have been told good news, as they were. But the message they heard did them no good, because they did not join in faith with those who truly listened.
en.R: We have heard good news, just as they did. But the message did not help them. They did not join in faith with the people who really listened to it.

es.L: Porque también a nosotros se nos ha anunciado la buena noticia, igual que a ellos; pero la palabra oída no les aprovechó a aquellos, por no estar unidos por la fe con los que oyeron.
es.B: Porque también a nosotros se nos ha anunciado la buena noticia, como a ellos. Pero el mensaje que oyeron no les sirvió de nada, porque no se unieron en la fe a los que de verdad escucharon.
es.R: Nosotros hemos oído la buena noticia, igual que ellos. Pero el mensaje no les sirvió de nada. No se unieron en la fe con la gente que de verdad lo escuchó.

fr.L: Car en effet une bonne nouvelle nous a été annoncée, tout comme à eux aussi ; mais la parole entendue n’a pas profité à ceux-là, parce qu’ils n’étaient pas unis par la foi à ceux qui avaient entendu.
fr.B: Car à nous aussi une bonne nouvelle a été annoncée, comme à eux. Mais le message qu’ils ont entendu ne leur a servi à rien, parce qu’ils ne se sont pas joints, par la foi, à ceux qui écoutaient vraiment.
fr.R: Nous avons entendu une bonne nouvelle, tout comme eux. Mais ce message ne les a pas aidés. Ils ne se sont pas unis dans la foi aux gens qui l’écoutaient vraiment.

sw.L: Kwa maana kweli tumeletewa habari njema, kama vile wao pia; lakini neno la kusikia halikuwafaa wale, kwa kuwa hawakuunganishwa kwa imani na wale waliosikia.
sw.B: Kwa maana sisi pia tumeambiwa habari njema, kama wao walivyoambiwa. Lakini ujumbe waliousikia haukuwasaidia chochote, kwa sababu hawakuungana kwa imani na wale waliosikiliza kwa kweli.
sw.R: Tumesikia habari njema, kama wao walivyosikia. Lakini ujumbe huo haukuwasaidia. Hawakuungana kwa imani na watu walioisikiliza kwa kweli.

vi.L: Vì quả thật chúng ta cũng đã được nghe tin tốt lành như họ; nhưng lời họ nghe đã không có ích gì cho họ, vì họ đã không hiệp với những người đã nghe bằng đức tin.
vi.B: Vì chúng ta cũng đã được nghe tin tốt lành như họ. Nhưng sứ điệp họ nghe chẳng có ích gì cho họ, vì họ đã không cùng có đức tin với những người thật sự lắng nghe.
vi.R: Chúng ta đã được nghe tin tốt lành, cũng như họ. Nhưng sứ điệp ấy đã không giúp gì cho họ. Họ đã không cùng tin như những người thật sự lắng nghe sứ điệp ấy.

ko.L: 참으로 우리도 그들과 마찬가지로 복음을 전해 받았습니다. 그러나 들은 말씀이 그들에게 유익이 되지 못하였습니다. 그들이 들은 사람들과 믿음으로 결합하지 않았기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 우리도 그들처럼 기쁜 소식을 들었습니다. 그러나 그들이 들은 말씀은 그들에게 아무 유익이 없었습니다. 그들이 참으로 귀 기울여 들은 사람들과 믿음으로 하나가 되지 않았기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 우리도 그들처럼 기쁜 소식을 들었습니다. 그러나 그 말씀은 그들에게 도움이 되지 못했습니다. 그들은 그 말씀을 참으로 귀 기울여 들은 사람들과 함께 믿지 않았습니다.

decisions.choice: had good news announced: God's promise of rest was good news for them and is good news for us
decisions.reason: The verb belongs with the noun for the gospel. For the wilderness generation the good news was God's promise of the land and of rest; for the readers it is the message of salvation spoken by the Lord (2:3).

decisions.choice: the word of hearing: the message they heard
decisions.reason: A Hebrew-shaped phrase for a message that is heard (compare 1 Thessalonians 2:13).

decisions.choice: they were not joined in faith with those who heard
alternatives: the word did not benefit them, because it was not mixed with faith in those who heard it
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT has the plural form συγκεκερασμένους, agreeing with "those": the people of the wilderness were not joined in faith with those who truly heard, that is, who listened and obeyed, such as Joshua and Caleb (Numbers 14:6-9). From general knowledge, this reading is found in P13, P46, Codex Alexandrinus, Codex Vaticanus and most manuscripts. A few manuscripts, Codex Sinaiticus among them, have the singular, agreeing with "the word": the word was not mixed with faith in those who heard it, which is the reading of the King James Version. Other manuscripts reword the last phrase. The singular is easier to understand, which may be why it arose. Reviewers must check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: heard: heard and responded
decisions.reason: Hearing in the full biblical sense is listening and obeying (3:7, "if you hear his voice").

decisions.choice: those who truly listened; the people who really listened to it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the full sense of hearing, as the meaning decision explains.

decisions.choice: good news
decisions.reason: The verb is rendered "have good news announced" or "be told good news", since the good news here includes the promise given to Israel.

decisions.choice: se nos ha anunciado la buena noticia
decisions.reason: "Evangelizar" now names a church's mission work and would make the wilderness generation sound like converts. The meaning decision is about God's promise of rest as good news, so Spanish says "anunciar la buena noticia", as in 4:6.

decisions.choice: une bonne nouvelle nous a été annoncée
decisions.reason: French "évangéliser" would be a literal match for the verb, but it now names a church activity; the good news here includes the promise given to Israel (m1), so every level says "une bonne nouvelle".

decisions.choice: "tin tốt lành" for the good news announced to Israel and to us (also 4:6)
decisions.reason: The good news here is God's promise of rest, told to Israel in the wilderness and to us (m1). "Tin Lành" with capitals names the gospel of Christ and the Protestant church, so it cannot be said of Israel's message; "tin tốt lành" says the same thing in plain words. "Tin mừng" is the Catholic word for the gospel.

decisions.choice: "복음을 전해 받다" (L); "기쁜 소식을 듣다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The good news here is God's promise of rest, which was good news for the wilderness generation as it is for the readers (meaning decision). Literal keeps the letters' word "복음"; Balanced says "기쁜 소식", since "복음" would suggest the Christian message only, and Readable says it as the Korean letters' Readable always does.

source.text: εἰσερχόμεθα γὰρ εἰς κατάπαυσιν οἱ πιστεύσαντες, καθὼς εἴρηκεν· Ὡς ὤμοσα ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ μου, Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου, καίτοι τῶν ἔργων ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου γενηθέντων, εἴρηκεν γάρ που περὶ τῆς ἑβδόμης οὕτως· Καὶ κατέπαυσεν ὁ θεὸς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν τούτῳ πάλιν· Εἰ εἰσελεύσονται εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσίν μου.

records.literal_gloss: We enter for into rest the [ones] having believed, just as he has said: As I swore in the anger of me, If they will enter into the rest of me, although the works from foundation of world having come about, \v 4 he has said for somewhere about the seventh thus: And rested the God on the day the seventh from all the works of him, \v 5 and in this again: If they will enter into the rest of me.

en.L: For we who have believed enter into rest, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has said, "As I swore in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger, 'They will not enter into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rest,'" although the works were finished from [the] foundation of [the] world. \v 4 For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has said somewhere about the seventh [day] thus: "And God rested on the seventh day from all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works"; \v 5 and in this [place] again: "They will not enter into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rest."
en.B: For it is we who have believed who enter that rest, just as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has said, "So in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger I swore an oath: 'They will never enter {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rest.'" Yet {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works had been finished since the world was founded. \v 4 For somewhere {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has spoken of the seventh day in these words: "And God rested on the seventh day from all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} works." \v 5 And in this passage again: "They will never enter {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rest."
en.R: We who have believed are the ones who enter that rest. God said, "So in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger I swore an oath: 'They will never enter {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rest.'" His work had been finished long before, ever since the world began. \v 4 In another place God speaks about the seventh day like this: "On the seventh day God rested from all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} work." \v 5 And in the psalm {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} says again, "They will never enter {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rest."

es.L: Porque los que hemos creído entramos en [el] reposo, tal como ha dicho: «Como juré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira: “No entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reposo”», aunque las obras quedaron terminadas desde [la] fundación del mundo. \v 4 Porque en algún lugar ha dicho así acerca del séptimo [día]: «Y reposó Dios en el séptimo día de todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras»; \v 5 y en este [lugar] otra vez: «No entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reposo».
es.B: Porque somos nosotros, los que hemos creído, los que entramos en ese reposo, tal como ha dicho: «Así que juré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira: “Jamás entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reposo”». Sin embargo, {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras estaban terminadas desde que el mundo fue fundado. \v 4 Porque en algún lugar ha hablado del séptimo día con estas palabras: «Y reposó Dios en el séptimo día de todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} obras». \v 5 Y otra vez en este pasaje: «Jamás entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reposo».
es.R: Los que hemos creído somos los que entramos en ese reposo. Dios dijo: «Así que juré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira: “Jamás entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reposo”». Su obra estaba terminada desde mucho antes, desde que comenzó el mundo. \v 4 En otro lugar Dios habla así del séptimo día: «En el séptimo día Dios reposó de toda {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} obra». \v 5 Y en el salmo dice otra vez: «Jamás entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reposo».

fr.L: Car nous entrons dans [le] repos, nous qui avons cru, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a dit : « Ainsi j’ai juré dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère : “Ils n’entreront pas dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos” », bien que les œuvres aient été achevées depuis [la] fondation du monde. \v 4 Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a dit quelque part, au sujet du septième [jour], ainsi : « Et Dieu se reposa le septième jour de toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres » ; \v 5 et dans ce [passage] encore : « Ils n’entreront pas dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos. »
fr.B: Car c’est nous, qui avons cru, qui entrons dans ce repos, comme {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a dit : « Alors, dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, j’ai juré : “Jamais ils n’entreront dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos.” » Pourtant, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres étaient achevées depuis la fondation du monde. \v 4 Car quelque part {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a parlé du septième jour en ces termes : « Et Dieu se reposa le septième jour de toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} œuvres. » \v 5 Et dans ce passage encore : « Jamais ils n’entreront dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos. »
fr.R: Nous qui avons cru, c’est nous qui entrons dans ce repos. Dieu a dit : « Alors, dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, j’ai juré : “Jamais ils n’entreront dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos.” » Pourtant, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} travail était terminé depuis longtemps, depuis le commencement du monde. \v 4 Ailleurs, Dieu parle du septième jour de cette façon : « Le septième jour, Dieu s’est reposé de tout {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} travail. » \v 5 Et dans le psaume, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} dit encore : « Jamais ils n’entreront dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos. »

sw.L: Kwa maana tunaingia katika pumziko sisi tulioamini, kama alivyonena, "Kama nilivyoapa katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, 'Hawataingia katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}},'" ingawa kazi zilikuwa zimekamilika tangu kuanzishwa kwa ulimwengu. \v 4 Kwa maana amenena mahali fulani kuhusu [siku ya] saba namna hii: "Na Mungu akapumzika siku ya saba kutoka katika kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote"; \v 5 na katika [mahali] hapa tena: "Hawataingia katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}."
sw.B: Kwa maana sisi tuliokwisha kuamini ndio tunaoingia katika pumziko hilo, kama alivyonena, "Basi katika ghadhabu {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} niliapa kiapo: 'Hawataingia kamwe katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.'" Hata hivyo kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zilikuwa zimekamilika tangu ulimwengu ulipoanzishwa. \v 4 Kwa maana mahali fulani amenena juu ya siku ya saba kwa maneno haya: "Na Mungu akapumzika siku ya saba kutoka katika kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} zote." \v 5 Tena katika sehemu hii: "Hawataingia kamwe katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}."
sw.R: Sisi tuliokwisha kuamini ndio tunaoingia katika pumziko hilo. Mungu alisema, "Basi kwa hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} niliapa: 'Hawataingia kamwe katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}.'" Kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ilikuwa imekamilika zamani, tangu ulimwengu ulipoanza. \v 4 Mahali pengine Mungu anazungumza juu ya siku ya saba hivi: "Siku ya saba Mungu alipumzika kutoka katika kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote." \v 5 Na katika zaburi anasema tena, "Hawataingia kamwe katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}."

vi.L: Vì chúng ta là những người đã tin thì vào sự yên nghỉ, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán: "Như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: 'Họ sẽ không được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}'", dù các công việc [của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}] đã hoàn tất từ khi sáng lập thế gian. \v 4 Vì có chỗ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về ngày thứ bảy như vầy: "Và Đức Chúa Trời yên nghỉ vào ngày thứ bảy khỏi mọi công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}"; \v 5 và ở chỗ này lại [phán]: "Họ sẽ không được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: Vì chính chúng ta, là những người đã tin, được vào sự yên nghỉ ấy, như {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán: "Nên trong cơn giận, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề: 'Họ sẽ không bao giờ được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'" Thế mà các công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hoàn tất từ khi sáng lập thế gian. \v 4 Vì có chỗ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán về ngày thứ bảy như sau: "Và Đức Chúa Trời yên nghỉ vào ngày thứ bảy khỏi mọi công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." \v 5 Và ở đoạn này {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại phán: "Họ sẽ không bao giờ được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: Chúng ta là những người đã tin, nên chúng ta được vào sự yên nghỉ ấy. Đức Chúa Trời đã phán: "Nên trong cơn giận, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề: 'Họ sẽ không bao giờ được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'" Công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hoàn tất từ lâu, ngay từ khi thế gian bắt đầu. \v 4 Ở một chỗ khác, Đức Chúa Trời nói về ngày thứ bảy như thế này: "Vào ngày thứ bảy, Đức Chúa Trời yên nghỉ khỏi mọi công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}." \v 5 Và trong thi thiên ấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại phán: "Họ sẽ không bao giờ được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: 믿은 우리는 안식에 들어갑니다. 그분이 말씀하신 것과 같습니다. "내가 진노하여 맹세한 것과 같이 '그들은 내 안식에 들어오지 못할 것이다.'" 그러나 세상의 기초가 놓일 때부터 그분의 일들은 이루어져 있었습니다. \v 4 그분은 일곱째 [날]에 대하여 어딘가에서 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다. "그리고 하나님께서 일곱째 날에 그분의 모든 일을 쉬셨다." \v 5 그리고 여기서 다시 "그들은 내 안식에 들어오지 못할 것이다" [하셨습니다].
ko.B: 믿은 우리가 바로 그 안식에 들어갑니다. 그분이 이렇게 말씀하신 것과 같습니다. "그래서 내가 진노하여 맹세하였다. '그들은 결코 내 안식에 들어오지 못할 것이다.'" 그러나 그분의 일은 세상을 지으실 때 이미 다 이루어져 있었습니다. \v 4 그분은 어디에선가 일곱째 날에 대하여 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다. "그리고 하나님께서 일곱째 날에 그분의 모든 일을 쉬셨다." \v 5 그리고 이 말씀에서 다시 "그들은 결코 내 안식에 들어오지 못할 것이다" 하셨습니다.
ko.R: 믿은 우리가 바로 그 안식에 들어가는 사람들입니다. 하나님께서는 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다. "그래서 나는 몹시 노하여 맹세하였다. '그들은 결코 내 안식에 들어오지 못할 것이다.'" 하나님의 일은 오래전, 세상이 시작될 때부터 이미 끝나 있었습니다. \v 4 다른 곳에서 하나님께서는 일곱째 날에 대하여 이렇게 말씀하십니다. "일곱째 날에 하나님께서 그분의 모든 일을 쉬셨다." \v 5 그리고 시편에서 다시 이렇게 말씀하십니다. "그들은 결코 내 안식에 들어오지 못할 것이다."

decisions.choice: we enter: believers enter God's rest now, and are still to enter it fully
decisions.reason: The present tense says that believers are already entering; yet 4:11 still urges them to make every effort to enter. The rest is begun by faith and completed at the end.

decisions.choice: Psalm 95:11 (94:11 Greek)
decisions.reason: The oath of the psalm quoted in 3:11 is quoted again, whole in 4:3 and in part in 4:5.

decisions.choice: God's works were finished at creation, so his rest has stood open since then
decisions.reason: The point is that the rest of the psalm is not only the land: it is God's own rest, which has existed since he finished his works. The wilderness generation failed to enter a rest that was already there.

decisions.choice: somewhere: a way of citing Scripture without naming the place
decisions.reason: The author does not mean he is unsure where the words are (compare 2:6); what matters is that God said them.

decisions.choice: Genesis 2:2
decisions.reason: The words follow the Greek of Genesis 2:2.

decisions.choice: he has said: God is the speaker of Scripture
decisions.reason: Throughout the letter Scripture is quoted as God speaking (1:5-13; 4:7), so the subject is God.

decisions.choice: rest
decisions.reason: "Rest" at every level, as in 3:11. Literal keeps "into rest" without the article; Balanced and Readable say "that rest".

decisions.choice: his works (God's works); the seventh day
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name whose works they were and supply "day".

decisions.choice: in the psalm
decisions.reason: Readable says which passage: Psalm 95, quoted in 3:7-11.

decisions.choice: the Spanish words of 3:11, unchanged
decisions.reason: Psalm 95:11 is quoted again here and in verse 5, so each level repeats its own wording of 3:11 ("No entrarán" at Literal, "Jamás entrarán" at Balanced and Readable), as the English does.

decisions.choice: ha dicho, with no subject pronoun
decisions.reason: Spanish leaves the subject in the verb, as the Greek does; an added "él" would be emphatic. Where the English has "he" for God as subject (also in 4:7-8), Spanish has no span, and Readable names God.

decisions.choice: se reposa (L, B); s’est reposé (R)
decisions.reason: Genesis 2:2 is narrative, so Literal and Balanced quote it in the passé simple, the tense of written narrative; Readable uses the passé composé, as it does everywhere. The psalm’s oath is quoted in the same words as in 3:11.

decisions.choice: dans [le] repos
decisions.reason: The Greek has no article and French cannot say "dans repos", so Literal brackets the article.

decisions.choice: "yên nghỉ" for God's resting in Genesis 2:2, the verb of the noun "sự yên nghỉ"
decisions.reason: The argument joins God's seventh-day rest to the rest of Psalm 95 (m3, m5); Vietnamese uses one word for both, so the reader sees the link the Greek makes.

decisions.choice: Psalm 95:11 worded as in 3:11 at each level
alternatives: a new wording for each quotation
decisions.reason: The writer quotes the same oath three times (3:11; 4:3; 4:5), so each level keeps one wording and the repetition is heard; Genesis 2:2 uses "쉬다", the verb behind "안식".

source.text: ἐπεὶ οὖν ἀπολείπεται τινὰς εἰσελθεῖν εἰς αὐτήν, καὶ οἱ πρότερον εὐαγγελισθέντες οὐκ εἰσῆλθον δι’ ἀπείθειαν, πάλιν τινὰ ὁρίζει ἡμέραν, Σήμερον, ἐν Δαυὶδ λέγων μετὰ τοσοῦτον χρόνον, καθὼς προείρηται, Σήμερον ἐὰν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ ἀκούσητε, μὴ σκληρύνητε τὰς καρδίας ὑμῶν·

records.literal_gloss: Since therefore it remains some to enter into it, and the [ones] formerly having had good news announced not entered because of disobedience, \v 7 again a certain he sets day, Today, in David saying after so long time, just as it has been said before: Today if the voice of him you hear, not harden the hearts of you;

en.L: Since therefore it remains for some to enter into it, and those who formerly had good news announced [to them] did not enter because of disobedience, \v 7 {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} again sets a certain day, "Today," saying in David after so long a time, just as it has been said before: "Today, if you hear {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice, do not harden your hearts."
en.B: So it is still left for some to enter that rest, and those who first heard the good news did not go in, because they would not obey. \v 7 For this reason God again marks out a certain day, "Today," speaking through David so long afterward, as was said above: "Today, if you hear {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice, do not harden your hearts."
en.R: So the way into that rest is still open for some to enter. Those who first heard the good news did not go in, because they did not obey. \v 7 So God set another day, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} calls it "Today." Long afterward {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} spoke of it through David, in the words we read above: "Today, if you hear {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice, do not make your hearts hard."

es.L: Así que, puesto que queda que algunos entren en él, y los que antes recibieron el anuncio de la buena noticia no entraron a causa de [su] desobediencia, \v 7 otra vez fija un día, «Hoy», diciendo en David después de tanto tiempo, tal como se ha dicho antes: «Hoy, si {{plural_you:oyen|oís}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz, no {{plural_you:endurezcan|endurezcáis}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones».
es.B: Así que todavía queda que algunos entren en ese reposo, y los que primero oyeron la buena noticia no entraron, porque no quisieron obedecer. \v 7 Por eso Dios vuelve a señalar un día, «Hoy», y habla por medio de David tanto tiempo después, como se dijo arriba: «Hoy, si {{plural_you:oyen|oís}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz, no {{plural_you:endurezcan|endurezcáis}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones».
es.R: Así que el camino a ese reposo sigue abierto para que algunos entren. Los que primero oyeron la buena noticia no entraron, porque no obedecieron. \v 7 Por eso Dios fijó otro día, y lo llama «Hoy». Mucho tiempo después habló de él por medio de David, con las palabras que leímos antes: «Hoy, si {{plural_you:oyen|oís}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz, no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} corazones se vuelvan duros».

fr.L: Puisque donc il reste que certains y entrent, et que ceux qui avaient autrefois reçu la bonne nouvelle n’y sont pas entrés à cause de [leur] désobéissance, \v 7 {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fixe de nouveau un certain jour, « Aujourd’hui », en disant dans David, après si longtemps, comme il a été dit auparavant : « Aujourd’hui, si vous entendez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix, n’endurcissez pas vos cœurs. »
fr.B: Il reste donc à certains d’entrer dans ce repos, et ceux qui ont reçu les premiers la bonne nouvelle n’y sont pas entrés, parce qu’ils ont refusé d’obéir. \v 7 C’est pourquoi Dieu fixe de nouveau un jour, « Aujourd’hui », en parlant par David si longtemps après, comme il a été dit plus haut : « Aujourd’hui, si vous entendez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix, n’endurcissez pas vos cœurs. »
fr.R: Le chemin vers ce repos reste donc ouvert, et certains y entreront. Ceux qui ont entendu les premiers la bonne nouvelle n’y sont pas entrés, parce qu’ils n’ont pas obéi. \v 7 Alors Dieu a fixé un autre jour, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’appelle « Aujourd’hui ». Longtemps après, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} en a parlé par David, avec les paroles que nous avons lues plus haut : « Aujourd’hui, si vous entendez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix, ne laissez pas vos cœurs devenir durs. »

sw.L: Basi, kwa kuwa inabaki kwamba wengine waingie humo, na wale waliotangulia kuletewa habari njema hawakuingia kwa sababu ya kutotii, \v 7 tena anaweka siku fulani, "Leo," akisema katika Daudi baada ya muda mrefu hivyo, kama ilivyokwisha kusemwa kabla: "Leo, mkiisikia sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, msiishupaze mioyo yenu."
sw.B: Basi bado imesalia nafasi kwa wengine kuingia katika pumziko hilo, na wale waliosikia habari njema kwanza hawakuingia, kwa sababu walikataa kutii. \v 7 Kwa sababu hiyo Mungu anaweka tena siku fulani, "Leo," akinena kupitia Daudi muda mrefu baadaye, kama ilivyosemwa hapo juu: "Leo, mkiisikia sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, msiishupaze mioyo yenu."
sw.R: Kwa hiyo njia ya kuingia katika pumziko hilo bado iko wazi kwa wengine. Wale waliosikia habari njema kwanza hawakuingia, kwa sababu hawakutii. \v 7 Basi Mungu aliweka siku nyingine, na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anaiita "Leo." Muda mrefu baadaye alinena juu yake kupitia Daudi, kwa maneno tuliyosoma hapo juu: "Leo, mkiisikia sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, msiifanye mioyo yenu kuwa migumu."

vi.L: Vậy, vì vẫn còn có một số người được vào đó, và những người trước kia đã được nghe tin tốt lành đã không vào vì sự không vâng lời, \v 7 nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} lại định một ngày, là "Ngày nay", khi phán qua Đa-vít sau một thời gian rất lâu, như đã được nói trước: "Ngày nay, nếu các ngươi nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì chớ cứng lòng."
vi.B: Vậy, vẫn còn có một số người sẽ được vào sự yên nghỉ ấy, còn những người được nghe tin tốt lành trước tiên thì đã không vào, vì họ không chịu vâng lời. \v 7 Vì thế Đức Chúa Trời lại định một ngày, là "Ngày nay", khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phán qua Đa-vít rất lâu về sau, như đã trích ở trên: "Ngày nay, nếu các ngươi nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì chớ cứng lòng."
vi.R: Vậy đường vào sự yên nghỉ ấy vẫn còn mở cho một số người bước vào. Những người được nghe tin tốt lành trước tiên đã không vào, vì họ không vâng lời. \v 7 Vì thế Đức Chúa Trời định một ngày khác, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gọi ngày ấy là "Ngày nay". Rất lâu về sau, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nói về ngày ấy qua Đa-vít, trong những lời chúng ta đã đọc ở trên: "Ngày nay, nếu các ngươi nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, thì đừng làm cho lòng mình cứng cỏi."

ko.L: 그러므로 어떤 사람들이 그 안식에 들어갈 일이 남아 있고, 전에 복음을 전해 받은 사람들은 불순종 때문에 들어가지 못하였으므로, \v 7 그분은 오랜 세월이 지난 뒤에 다윗을 통하여 말씀하시면서 다시 어떤 날을 "오늘"이라고 정하십니다. 앞에서 말한 것과 같습니다. "오늘 너희가 그분의 음성을 듣거든, 너희 마음을 완고하게 하지 마라."
ko.B: 그러므로 어떤 사람들은 아직 그 안식에 들어갈 수 있습니다. 그런데 기쁜 소식을 먼저 들은 사람들은 순종하지 않았기 때문에 들어가지 못하였습니다. \v 7 그래서 하나님께서는 그렇게 오랜 세월이 지난 뒤에 다윗을 통하여 말씀하시면서, 다시 "오늘"이라는 어떤 날을 정하셨습니다. 앞에서 인용한 대로입니다. "오늘 너희가 그분의 음성을 듣거든, 너희 마음을 완고하게 하지 마라."
ko.R: 그러므로 그 안식에 들어가는 길은 아직 어떤 사람들에게 열려 있습니다. 기쁜 소식을 먼저 들은 사람들은 순종하지 않았기 때문에 들어가지 못했습니다. \v 7 그래서 하나님께서는 다른 날을 정하시고 그날을 "오늘"이라고 부르십니다. 오랜 세월이 지난 뒤에 하나님께서는 다윗을 통하여 그날에 대하여 말씀하셨습니다. 우리가 앞에서 읽은 말씀이 바로 그것입니다. "오늘 너희가 그분의 음성을 듣거든, 너희 마음을 굳게 닫지 마라."

decisions.choice: disobedience: refusing to obey
decisions.reason: As in 3:18-19, disobedience and unbelief are one failure seen from two sides.

decisions.choice: in David: through David, or in the book of Psalms that bears his name
decisions.reason: The Hebrew Psalm 95 has no title, but in the Greek psalm it is headed as David's. Either way the psalm was spoken long after Joshua led the people into the land, so God's offer of rest was still open.

decisions.choice: God fixes a day and names it "Today"
decisions.reason: ὁρίζω means to set or appoint a time; God appoints a new day of opportunity.

decisions.choice: Psalm 95:7-8 (94:7-8 Greek)
decisions.reason: Quoted already in 3:7-8 and 3:15; "as has been said before" points back to those places.

decisions.choice: Today
decisions.reason: As in 3:7.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: The subject is God, as in 4:3-4.

decisions.choice: two sentences: "So it is still left ..."; "For this reason God ..."
decisions.reason: Balanced splits the long sentence and says how the two parts are linked.

decisions.choice: the Spanish words of 3:7-8, unchanged
decisions.reason: The psalm is quoted a third time, so each level repeats its wording of 3:7-8 and 3:15 word for word, as the English does.

decisions.choice: dans David (L); par David (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the ambiguity of the Greek (m2): "dans David" can mean the book of Psalms, as one says "dans Isaïe". Balanced and Readable say "par David", through David, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "다윗을 통하여" (L) for "in David"
decisions.reason: The phrase means through David, or in the book of Psalms that bears his name (meaning decision); Korean "다윗 안에서" would not be understood, so Literal says "through", which covers both.

source.text: εἰ γὰρ αὐτοὺς Ἰησοῦς κατέπαυσεν, οὐκ ἂν περὶ ἄλλης ἐλάλει μετὰ ταῦτα ἡμέρας.

records.literal_gloss: If for them Joshua gave rest, not would about another he speak after these [things] day.

en.L: For if Joshua had given them rest, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would not speak about another day after these [things].
en.B: If Joshua had brought them into rest, God would not afterward speak of a different day.
en.R: Joshua led the people into the land, but that was not the rest God meant. If Joshua had given them that rest, God would not have gone on, years later, to speak about another day.

es.L: Porque si Josué les hubiera dado reposo, no hablaría después de estas [cosas] acerca de otro día.
es.B: Si Josué los hubiera hecho entrar en el reposo, Dios no hablaría después de otro día distinto.
es.R: Josué llevó al pueblo a la tierra, pero ese no era el reposo al que Dios se refería. Si Josué les hubiera dado ese reposo, Dios no habría hablado, años más tarde, de otro día.

fr.L: Car si Josué leur avait donné le repos, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} ne parlerait pas après ces [choses] d’un autre jour.
fr.B: Si Josué les avait fait entrer dans le repos, Dieu n’aurait pas, par la suite, parlé d’un autre jour.
fr.R: Josué a conduit le peuple dans le pays, mais ce n’était pas le repos dont Dieu parlait. Si Josué leur avait donné ce repos, Dieu n’aurait pas, des années plus tard, parlé d’un autre jour.

sw.L: Kwa maana kama Yoshua angaliwapa pumziko, asingalinena juu ya siku nyingine baada ya hayo.
sw.B: Kama Yoshua angaliwaingiza katika pumziko, Mungu asingalinena baadaye juu ya siku nyingine.
sw.R: Yoshua aliwaongoza watu kuingia katika nchi, lakini hilo halikuwa pumziko ambalo Mungu alimaanisha. Kama Yoshua angaliwapa pumziko hilo, Mungu asingeendelea, miaka mingi baadaye, kunena juu ya siku nyingine.

vi.L: Vì nếu Giô-suê đã cho họ sự yên nghỉ, thì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã không phán về một ngày khác sau đó.
vi.B: Nếu Giô-suê đã đưa họ vào sự yên nghỉ, thì về sau Đức Chúa Trời đã không phán về một ngày khác nữa.
vi.R: Giô-suê đã dẫn dân chúng vào xứ, nhưng đó không phải là sự yên nghỉ mà Đức Chúa Trời muốn nói. Nếu Giô-suê đã cho họ sự yên nghỉ ấy, thì nhiều năm sau Đức Chúa Trời đã không còn phán về một ngày khác.

ko.L: 만일 여호수아가 그들에게 안식을 주었다면, 그분은 그 뒤에 다른 날에 대하여 말씀하지 않으셨을 것입니다.
ko.B: 만일 여호수아가 그들을 안식에 들어가게 하였다면, 하나님께서는 그 뒤에 다른 날에 대하여 말씀하지 않으셨을 것입니다.
ko.R: 여호수아는 백성을 약속의 땅으로 이끌었지만, 그것은 하나님께서 말씀하신 안식이 아니었습니다. 만일 여호수아가 그들에게 그 안식을 주었다면, 하나님께서는 여러 해가 지난 뒤에 다른 날에 대하여 말씀하지 않으셨을 것입니다.

decisions.choice: Joshua, son of Nun
decisions.reason: In Greek, Joshua's name is the same as the name Jesus; both come from the Hebrew name Yehoshua. Here it means Joshua, who led Israel into the land. The reader of the Greek hears the echo: the first Joshua could not give the final rest, but Jesus leads God's children into glory (2:10; 4:14).

decisions.choice: Joshua 21:44; 22:4; Deuteronomy 12:9-10
decisions.reason: The book of Joshua says that God gave Israel rest in the land. The author argues that this was not the final rest, because Psalm 95, written later, still offers it.

decisions.choice: a condition contrary to fact: Joshua did not give the final rest
decisions.reason: The form of the sentence assumes the first part is not true. The subject of "would speak" is God, the speaker of the psalm.

decisions.choice: Joshua
decisions.reason: Every level says "Joshua", the person meant; an older English Bible rendered the name "Jesus" here.

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: The subject is God.

decisions.choice: Joshua led the people into the land, but that was not the rest God meant.
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the step the argument assumes.

decisions.choice: Josué
decisions.reason: The Greek name is the same as Jesus' name, but here it is Joshua, son of Nun (m1). Spanish Bibles call him "Josué", the name readers know from the book of Joshua.

decisions.choice: "Giô-suê" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek name is the same as Jesus's, but the man is Joshua son of Nun (m1). Vietnamese gives him the Protestant form of his own name, so that he is not confused with Jesus, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "여호수아" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek gives Joshua the same name as Jesus (meaning decision, footnoted). Korean, like the English, uses the established Protestant form of Joshua's name, so the reader is not misled; the footnote explains the play on the name.

source.text: ἄρα ἀπολείπεται σαββατισμὸς τῷ λαῷ τοῦ θεοῦ·

records.literal_gloss: So remains a Sabbath rest for the people of the God;

en.L: So then a Sabbath rest remains for the people of God;
en.B: So a Sabbath rest is still waiting for God's people.
en.R: So God's people still have a Sabbath rest waiting for them.

es.L: Así que queda un reposo sabático para el pueblo de Dios;
es.B: Así pues, un reposo sabático sigue esperando al pueblo de Dios.
es.R: Así que al pueblo de Dios todavía le espera un reposo sabático.

fr.L: Il reste donc un repos du sabbat pour le peuple de Dieu ;
fr.B: Un repos du sabbat attend donc encore le peuple de Dieu.
fr.R: Le peuple de Dieu a donc encore un repos du sabbat qui l’attend.

sw.L: Basi pumziko la Sabato linabaki kwa watu wa Mungu;
sw.B: Kwa hiyo pumziko la Sabato bado linawangoja watu wa Mungu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo watu wa Mungu bado wana pumziko la Sabato linalowangoja.

vi.L: Vậy thì vẫn còn một sự nghỉ ngơi ngày Sa-bát dành cho dân của Đức Chúa Trời;
vi.B: Vậy, một sự nghỉ ngơi ngày Sa-bát vẫn còn đang chờ đợi dân của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Vậy dân của Đức Chúa Trời vẫn còn một sự nghỉ ngơi ngày Sa-bát đang chờ họ.

ko.L: 그러므로 하나님의 백성에게는 안식일의 안식이 남아 있습니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 하나님의 백성에게는 안식일의 안식이 아직 기다리고 있습니다.
ko.R: 그러므로 하나님의 백성에게는 안식일의 쉼이 아직 기다리고 있습니다.

decisions.choice: Sabbath rest: a festive keeping of Sabbath, sharing God's seventh-day rest
decisions.reason: Here the author changes from κατάπαυσις to σαββατισμός, a word made from "Sabbath". No earlier use of it is known in surviving Greek writing. It ties the rest that remains to God's rest on the seventh day (4:4, 4:10): God's people are to share the joy and completion of his own Sabbath.

decisions.choice: so then: the conclusion of 4:3-8
decisions.reason: Since the psalm speaks of rest long after Joshua, the rest is still to come.

decisions.choice: Sabbath rest
decisions.reason: A different word from "rest" elsewhere in the passage, so it is rendered differently at every level.

decisions.choice: reposo sabático
decisions.reason: "Sabatismo" is the Greek word carried over and means nothing to most readers. "Reposo sabático" keeps both the link with God's "reposo" in verses 1-10 and the Sabbath picture of m1.

decisions.choice: un repos du sabbat
decisions.reason: The new word of this verse (m1) is rendered differently from "repos" elsewhere, and "du sabbat" says plainly that it is the rest of the seventh day. "sabbatisme" exists in French but is rare and technical.

decisions.choice: "sự nghỉ ngơi ngày Sa-bát" at every level
decisions.reason: This is a different word from "rest" in 3:11-4:8: a festive keeping of Sabbath, sharing God's seventh-day rest (m1). "Nghỉ ngơi ngày Sa-bát" keeps it apart from "sự yên nghỉ" while naming the Sabbath, "ngày Sa-bát" as in the style guide.

decisions.choice: "안식일의 안식" (L, B); "안식일의 쉼" (R)
decisions.reason: The writer uses a new word here, a festive keeping of Sabbath that shares God's seventh-day rest (meaning decision), so Korean names the Sabbath (안식일), and Readable says the rest in a plain native word.

source.text: ὁ γὰρ εἰσελθὼν εἰς τὴν κατάπαυσιν αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς κατέπαυσεν ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ ὥσπερ ἀπὸ τῶν ἰδίων ὁ θεός.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] for having entered into the rest of him also himself rested from the works of him just as from the own the God.

en.L: For the [one] who has entered into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} rest has also rested from {{gender:their|his}} works, just as God [did] from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own.
en.B: For whoever has entered God's rest has come to rest from {{gender:their|his}} own works too, just as God did from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}.
en.R: When people enter God's rest, they stop their own work, as God stopped {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} work on the seventh day.

es.L: Porque el que ha entrado en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} reposo también ha reposado de sus obras, así como Dios [lo hizo] de las {{deity_pronoun:suyas|Suyas}}.
es.B: Porque quien ha entrado en el reposo de Dios también ha reposado de sus propias obras, así como Dios reposó de las {{deity_pronoun:suyas|Suyas}}.
es.R: Cuando las personas entran en el reposo de Dios, dejan de hacer su propio trabajo, como Dios dejó de hacer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} trabajo el séptimo día.

fr.L: Car celui qui est entré dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} repos s’est lui aussi reposé de ses œuvres, comme Dieu des {{deity_pronoun:siennes|Siennes}}.
fr.B: Car celui qui est entré dans le repos de Dieu s’est reposé, lui aussi, de ses propres œuvres, comme Dieu des {{deity_pronoun:siennes|Siennes}}.
fr.R: Ceux qui entrent dans le repos de Dieu arrêtent leur propre travail, comme Dieu a arrêté {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} travail le septième jour.

sw.L: Kwa maana aliyeingia katika pumziko {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} amepumzika naye kutoka katika kazi zake, kama Mungu [alivyopumzika] kutoka [kazi] {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana yeyote aliyeingia katika pumziko la Mungu amepumzika pia kutoka katika kazi zake mwenyewe, kama Mungu alivyopumzika kutoka katika kazi {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.R: Watu wanapoingia katika pumziko la Mungu, wanaacha kazi yao wenyewe, kama Mungu alivyoacha kazi {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} siku ya saba.

vi.L: Vì người đã vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thì cũng đã yên nghỉ khỏi các công việc của mình, như Đức Chúa Trời [đã yên nghỉ] khỏi [các công việc] của chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì ai đã vào sự yên nghỉ của Đức Chúa Trời thì cũng đã thôi các công việc của chính mình, như Đức Chúa Trời đã thôi các công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi người ta vào sự yên nghỉ của Đức Chúa Trời, họ thôi làm công việc của mình, như Đức Chúa Trời đã thôi công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vào ngày thứ bảy.

ko.L: 그분의 안식에 들어간 사람은, 하나님께서 자기의 일들을 쉬신 것처럼, 그 사람 자신도 자기 일들을 쉬었습니다.
ko.B: 하나님의 안식에 들어간 사람은 누구든지, 하나님께서 그분의 일을 쉬신 것처럼 자기 일을 쉬게 된 것입니다.
ko.R: 사람들이 하나님의 안식에 들어가면, 하나님께서 일곱째 날에 그분의 일을 쉬신 것처럼 자기 일을 멈춥니다.

decisions.choice: his rest: God's rest
decisions.reason: As in 4:1 and 4:3, the rest is God's.

decisions.choice: the one who has entered: any believer who enters God's rest
alternatives: Jesus, who entered God's rest when he finished his work
decisions.reason: The general statements around this verse (4:3, 4:11) suggest that anyone who enters is meant. The singular and the past tense have led some to read it of Jesus, who sat down after making purification for sins (1:3; 10:12) and has gone ahead of us (6:20).

decisions.choice: resting from one's works, as God rested from his
alternatives: ceasing to rely on good deeds
decisions.reason: The picture comes from Genesis 2:2: God finished his works and rested. Those who enter his rest share it. The verse is about entering rest, not about deeds and earning, which is a different subject (Romans 4:4-5).

decisions.choice: God's rest
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name whose rest it is.

decisions.choice: {{gender:their|his}}
decisions.reason: The one who enters is anyone, man or woman.

decisions.choice: on the seventh day
decisions.reason: Readable reminds the reader of 4:4.

decisions.choice: sus obras, no gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as in the English
decisions.reason: Spanish "sus" (their / his) does not mark whether the one who enters is a man or a woman, so the gender setting the English uses has nothing to change. "El que" and "quien" are the generic forms.

decisions.choice: kazi zake, no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "zake" means his or her, so the English gender span (their / his) has nothing to switch in Swahili.

decisions.choice: ses œuvres, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English needs {{gender:their|his}} because "his" names a man. French "ses" agrees with "œuvres" and says nothing about the person’s sex, so no setting is needed; "celui qui" is the generic "whoever".

decisions.choice: "người", "ai", "của mình", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "người", "ai" and the reflexive "mình" include women and men, so the English their/his setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: "자기 일" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean "자기" (one's own) says "their" or "his" for anyone, so the gender setting has nothing to change.

source.text: σπουδάσωμεν οὖν εἰσελθεῖν εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν κατάπαυσιν, ἵνα μὴ ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ τις ὑποδείγματι πέσῃ τῆς ἀπειθείας.

records.literal_gloss: Let us be eager therefore to enter into that the rest, so that not in the same anyone example falls of the disobedience.

en.L: Let us therefore be eager to enter into that rest, so that no one falls in the same example of disobedience.
en.B: So let us make it our urgent aim to enter that rest, so that no one falls into the same pattern of disobedience.
en.R: So let us work hard to enter that rest. Then none of us will fall by disobeying God, as they did.

es.L: Esforcémonos, pues, por entrar en aquel reposo, para que nadie caiga en el mismo ejemplo de desobediencia.
es.B: Así que pongamos todo nuestro empeño en entrar en ese reposo, para que nadie caiga en el mismo patrón de desobediencia.
es.R: Así que hagamos todo lo posible por entrar en ese reposo. Así ninguno de nosotros caerá por desobedecer a Dios, como cayeron ellos.

fr.L: Hâtons-nous donc d’entrer dans ce repos-là, afin que nul ne tombe dans le même exemple de désobéissance.
fr.B: Ayons donc à cœur d’entrer sans tarder dans ce repos, pour que nul ne tombe en reproduisant cette même désobéissance.
fr.R: Faisons donc tous nos efforts pour entrer dans ce repos. Alors aucun de nous ne tombera en désobéissant à Dieu, comme eux l’ont fait.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo tujitahidi kuingia katika pumziko hilo, ili asiwepo yeyote atakayeanguka katika kielelezo kile kile cha kutotii.
sw.B: Basi tuweke juhudi zetu zote kuingia katika pumziko hilo, ili mtu yeyote asianguke katika mtindo ule ule wa kutotii.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo tujitahidi sana kuingia katika pumziko hilo. Hapo hakuna hata mmoja wetu atakayeanguka kwa kutomtii Mungu, kama wao walivyofanya.

vi.L: Vậy, chúng ta hãy nỗ lực vào sự yên nghỉ ấy, để không ai sa ngã theo cùng gương không vâng lời đó.
vi.B: Vậy, chúng ta hãy hết sức nỗ lực để vào sự yên nghỉ ấy, để không ai sa ngã vào cùng một kiểu không vâng lời như thế.
vi.R: Vậy chúng ta hãy cố gắng hết sức để vào sự yên nghỉ ấy. Như thế sẽ không ai trong chúng ta sa ngã vì không vâng lời Đức Chúa Trời, như họ đã làm.

ko.L: 그러므로 우리는 저 안식에 들어가기를 힘씁시다. 아무도 그와 같은 불순종의 본을 따라 넘어지지 않게 하려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러므로 우리는 그 안식에 들어가기를 힘써 서두릅시다. 아무도 그들과 같은 불순종의 본을 따라 넘어지는 일이 없게 합시다.
ko.R: 그러므로 그 안식에 들어가기 위하여 열심히 힘씁시다. 그러면 우리 가운데 아무도 그들처럼 하나님께 순종하지 않다가 넘어지는 일이 없을 것입니다.

decisions.choice: be eager: make haste, put real effort into it
decisions.reason: σπουδάζω means hurrying, being in earnest. It is urgency in holding to faith (4:3), not earning the rest.

decisions.choice: example: a pattern to be avoided
decisions.reason: ὑπόδειγμα is a model or example. The wilderness generation is a warning pattern of disobedience. Later in the letter the same word means a copy of the heavenly sanctuary (8:5; 9:23).

decisions.choice: fall: come to ruin, as their bodies fell in the wilderness
decisions.reason: The verb picks up 3:17.

decisions.choice: by disobeying God, as they did
alternatives: in the same example of disobedience
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly whose example it is.

source.text: Ζῶν γὰρ ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐνεργὴς καὶ τομώτερος ὑπὲρ πᾶσαν μάχαιραν δίστομον καὶ διϊκνούμενος ἄχρι μερισμοῦ ψυχῆς καὶ πνεύματος, ἁρμῶν τε καὶ μυελῶν, καὶ κριτικὸς ἐνθυμήσεων καὶ ἐννοιῶν καρδίας·

records.literal_gloss: Living for [is] the word of the God and active and sharper beyond every sword two-mouthed and piercing as far as division of soul and of spirit, of joints both and of marrows, and able to judge of thoughts and of intentions of heart;

en.L: For living [is] the word of God, and at work, and sharper than any two-mouthed sword, and piercing as far as [the] dividing of soul and spirit, of joints and marrow, and able to judge [the] thoughts and purposes of [the] heart;
en.B: For the word of God is alive and at work, and it has a keener edge than any two-edged sword. It reaches right in, cutting through soul and spirit, through joints and marrow, and it weighs the thoughts and purposes of the heart.
en.R: God's word is alive, and it is at work. It is sharper than any sword, even one with two edges. It goes all the way in, through soul and spirit, through joints and marrow. It judges what we think and what we intend in our hearts.

es.L: Porque viva [es] la palabra de Dios, y activa, y más cortante que toda espada de dos bocas, y atraviesa hasta [la] división de alma y de espíritu, de articulaciones y de médulas, y es capaz de juzgar [los] pensamientos y propósitos del corazón;
es.B: Porque la palabra de Dios está viva y en acción, y corta mejor que cualquier espada afilada por ambos lados. Entra hasta el fondo, y atraviesa alma y espíritu, articulaciones y médula; y sopesa los pensamientos y los propósitos del corazón.
es.R: La palabra de Dios está viva, y está obrando. Corta más que cualquier espada, aun una que tenga filo por los dos lados. Entra hasta el fondo, atravesando el alma y el espíritu, las articulaciones y la médula. Juzga lo que pensamos y lo que nos proponemos en el corazón.

fr.L: Car vivante [est] la parole de Dieu, et agissante, et plus acérée que toute épée à deux bouches, et pénétrant jusqu’à [la] division d’âme et d’esprit, d’articulations et de moelles, et apte à juger les réflexions et les intentions du cœur ;
fr.B: Car la parole de Dieu est vivante et à l’œuvre ; son tranchant est plus vif que celui de toute épée à double tranchant. Elle s’enfonce jusqu’au plus profond, passant à travers l’âme et l’esprit, à travers les articulations et la moelle, et elle pèse les pensées et les intentions du cœur.
fr.R: La parole de Dieu est vivante, et elle agit. Elle est plus coupante que n’importe quelle épée, même une épée à deux tranchants. Elle entre jusqu’au fond, à travers l’âme et l’esprit, à travers les articulations et la moelle. Elle juge nos pensées et ce que nous voulons au fond de notre cœur.

sw.L: Kwa maana neno la Mungu [ni] hai na lenye kutenda kazi, na kali zaidi kuliko upanga wowote wenye vinywa viwili, na lenye kupenya hata kufikia kugawanywa kwa nafsi na roho, kwa viungo na uboho, na lenye uwezo wa kuhukumu mawazo na nia za moyo;
sw.B: Kwa maana neno la Mungu liko hai na linafanya kazi, nalo lina makali kuliko upanga wowote wenye makali pande mbili. Linapenya ndani kabisa, likikata kupitia nafsi na roho, kupitia viungo na uboho, nalo linapima mawazo na nia za moyo.
sw.R: Neno la Mungu liko hai, nalo linafanya kazi. Ni kali kuliko upanga wowote, hata ule wenye makali pande zote mbili. Linaingia ndani kabisa, kupitia nafsi na roho, kupitia viungo na uboho. Linahukumu yale tunayofikiri na yale tunayokusudia mioyoni mwetu.

vi.L: Vì lời của Đức Chúa Trời là sống và linh nghiệm, sắc hơn mọi gươm hai lưỡi, và đâm thấu đến chỗ phân chia hồn và linh, khớp xương và tủy, và có thể xét đoán các ý tưởng và ý định của lòng;
vi.B: Vì lời của Đức Chúa Trời là sống và đang hành động, sắc bén hơn mọi thanh gươm hai lưỡi. Lời ấy đâm thấu vào tận bên trong, xuyên qua hồn và linh, qua khớp xương và tủy, và xét đoán các ý tưởng và ý định của lòng.
vi.R: Lời của Đức Chúa Trời là lời sống và đang hành động. Lời ấy sắc bén hơn bất cứ thanh gươm nào, kể cả gươm có hai lưỡi. Lời ấy đi vào tận bên trong, xuyên qua hồn và linh, qua khớp xương và tủy. Lời ấy xét đoán những điều chúng ta nghĩ và những điều chúng ta định làm trong lòng.

ko.L: 하나님의 말씀은 살아 있고 활동하며, 어떤 두 입 가진 칼보다도 더 날카로워서, 혼과 영과 관절과 골수를 쪼개기까지 꿰뚫으며, 마음의 생각들과 뜻들을 판단합니다.
ko.B: 하나님의 말씀은 살아 있고 힘 있게 일하며, 어떤 양날 칼보다도 더 예리합니다. 그 말씀은 깊이 파고들어 혼과 영을, 관절과 골수를 쪼개며, 마음의 생각과 뜻을 가려냅니다.
ko.R: 하나님의 말씀은 살아 있고, 지금도 일하고 있습니다. 그 말씀은 어떤 칼보다도, 양쪽에 날이 선 칼보다도 더 날카롭습니다. 그 말씀은 혼과 영을 지나, 관절과 골수까지 깊이 들어갑니다. 그 말씀은 우리가 마음속으로 무엇을 생각하고 무엇을 하려는지 판단합니다.

decisions.choice: the word of God: what God says, here the word of Psalm 95 that still speaks "Today"
decisions.reason: The passage has been about God speaking in the psalm (3:7; 4:2, 4:7). That word is alive: it calls and warns now, and it judges. It is not here a title of Christ.

decisions.choice: at work: active, effective
decisions.reason: ἐνεργής describes something that is working and has effect (Philemon 6; 1 Corinthians 16:9).

decisions.choice: a two-mouthed sword: a sword sharpened on both edges
decisions.reason: The edge of a sword is pictured as a mouth that devours (Proverbs 5:4; Revelation 1:16).

decisions.choice: it reaches the innermost parts of a person
alternatives: it separates the soul from the spirit as two parts
decisions.reason: The pairs "soul and spirit" and "joints and marrow" are a picture of reaching as deep as anything can go. The author is not teaching how soul and spirit differ.

decisions.choice: able to judge the thoughts and purposes of the heart
decisions.reason: κριτικός means able to judge or sift. ἐνθύμησις are thoughts or reflections; ἔννοια are intentions, what a person has in mind.

decisions.choice: two-mouthed
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the Greek word.

decisions.choice: at work; weighs, judges
decisions.reason: Plain words for what the word of God does.

decisions.choice: four short sentences
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the sentence into its parts.

decisions.choice: espada de dos bocas
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of a sword with two "mouths", as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say what it means, a blade sharpened on both edges (m3).

decisions.choice: en acción, obrando; sopesa, juzga
decisions.reason: "Eficaz" and "discierne" are the words of the familiar Spanish versions of this verse. "Está viva y en acción" and "sopesa" follow the English ("at work", "weighs") and m2 and m5, and keep the sentence independent of those versions.

decisions.choice: upanga wenye vinywa viwili (L); upanga wenye makali pande mbili (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek picture of a two-mouthed sword, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable say what it means, a blade sharpened on both edges (m3).

decisions.choice: uboho (marrow); nia (purposes, intentions)
decisions.reason: "uboho" is the standard word for bone marrow. "nia" is what a person intends, the inner purpose that God's word judges (m5).

decisions.choice: épée à deux bouches (L); à double tranchant, à deux tranchants (B, R); agissante, à l’œuvre, agit
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of the Greek word, as the English Literal does. "agissante" and "à l’œuvre" say that the word is at work (m2) more plainly than the familiar "efficace", which today suggests efficiency.

decisions.choice: "gươm hai lưỡi" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek "two-mouthed" is an idiom for a sword sharpened on both edges (m3); Vietnamese "lưỡi" is the edge of a blade, so "hai lưỡi" keeps both the idiom's sense and its picture of a blade's mouths without a literal word that would not be understood.

decisions.choice: "두 입 가진 칼" (L); "양날 칼" (B); "양쪽에 날이 선 칼" (R); "혼" and "영" for soul and spirit
decisions.reason: The Greek calls a sword's edges its mouths (meaning decision); Literal keeps the picture, as the English Literal does, and the other levels say what it means. "혼" and "영" keep the two Greek words apart.

source.text: καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν κτίσις ἀφανὴς ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ, πάντα δὲ γυμνὰ καὶ τετραχηλισμένα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ, πρὸς ὃν ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος.

records.literal_gloss: And not is creature hidden before him, all [things] but naked and laid bare to the eyes of him, to whom for us the word.

en.L: And there is no creature hidden before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, but all [things are] naked and laid open to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes, to whom [we must give our] account.
en.B: No created thing is concealed from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. All things are stripped bare and open to the eyes of the one we must answer to.
en.R: Nothing God has made can hide from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Everything stands bare and open before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes. And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is the one we must answer to.

es.L: Y no hay criatura oculta delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, sino que todas [las cosas están] desnudas y expuestas a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos, ante quien [tenemos que dar] cuenta.
es.B: Ninguna cosa creada se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} oculta. Todo está al descubierto y expuesto a los ojos de aquel a quien tenemos que rendir cuentas.
es.R: Nada de lo que Dios ha hecho puede esconderse de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Todo está desnudo y a la vista ante {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos. Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es aquel ante quien tenemos que responder.

fr.L: Et il n’y a pas de créature cachée devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, mais toutes [choses sont] nues et exposées à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} à qui nous [devons rendre] compte.
fr.B: Rien de ce qui a été créé ne {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} est caché. Tout se trouve mis à nu, exposé aux yeux de celui devant qui nous aurons à répondre.
fr.R: Rien de ce que Dieu a fait ne peut se cacher de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Tout est découvert et visible devant {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux. Et c’est à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} que nous devrons rendre des comptes.

sw.L: Na hakuna kiumbe kilichojificha mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, bali vitu vyote [viko] uchi na vimefunuliwa mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ambaye [tutampa] hesabu [yetu].
sw.B: Hakuna kitu kilichoumbwa kilichofichika mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Vitu vyote vimevuliwa kila kifuniko na viko wazi mbele ya macho ya yule ambaye tunapaswa kumjibu.
sw.R: Hakuna kitu chochote alichokiumba Mungu kinachoweza kujificha asikione. Kila kitu kiko wazi, bila kifuniko, mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye tunayepaswa kumjibu.

vi.L: Và không có tạo vật nào bị che khuất trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, nhưng mọi sự đều trần trụi và phơi bày trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, là Đấng mà chúng ta [phải] khai trình.
vi.B: Không có tạo vật nào giấu được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mọi sự đều trần trụi và phơi bày trước mắt Đấng mà chúng ta phải khai trình.
vi.R: Không có vật gì Đức Chúa Trời đã dựng nên có thể trốn khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Mọi sự đều trần trụi và phơi bày trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng mà chúng ta phải trả lời về mọi việc mình làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그분 앞에 숨겨진 피조물은 하나도 없고, 모든 것이 그분의 눈앞에 벌거벗은 채 드러나 있습니다. 우리는 그분께 [셈을 해 드려야 합니다].
ko.B: 어떤 피조물도 그분 앞에서 숨을 수 없습니다. 모든 것이 우리가 셈을 해 드려야 할 분의 눈앞에 벌거벗은 채 드러나 있습니다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 지으신 것 가운데 어떤 것도 그분에게서 숨을 수 없습니다. 모든 것이 그분의 눈앞에 그대로 드러나 있습니다. 그리고 우리는 그분 앞에서 우리가 한 일을 다 말씀드려야 합니다.

decisions.choice: him: God
decisions.reason: The word of God in 4:12 passes into God himself, who speaks it: nothing can hide from him.

decisions.choice: laid open: exposed, helpless
decisions.reason: τραχηλίζομαι comes from the word for neck: to bend back the neck, as a wrestler does to an opponent or as a victim's throat is bared. Everything is exposed to God.

decisions.choice: the one to whom we must give account
alternatives: the one with whom we have to do
the one we are speaking about
decisions.reason: The phrase reads "to whom for us the word". λόγος here means an account, as of a debt or a life. The author plays on the word: the word God speaks to us (4:12), and the account we give to him.

decisions.choice: the one we must answer to
alternatives: to whom we must give account
decisions.reason: Plain words for giving an account.

decisions.choice: [we must give our] account
decisions.reason: Literal supplies the words the short Greek phrase leaves out.

source.text: Ἔχοντες οὖν ἀρχιερέα μέγαν διεληλυθότα τοὺς οὐρανούς, Ἰησοῦν τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ θεοῦ, κρατῶμεν τῆς ὁμολογίας·

records.literal_gloss: Having therefore high priest great having passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of the God, let us hold fast the confession;

en.L: Having therefore a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast the confession;
en.B: We have, then, a great high priest who has gone through the heavens: Jesus the Son of God. So let us keep a firm grip on the confession we make.
en.R: Jesus, the Son of God, is our great high priest. He has gone through the heavens into God's presence. So let us hold on tightly to the faith we confess.

es.L: Teniendo, pues, un gran sumo sacerdote que ha atravesado los cielos, Jesús el Hijo de Dios, retengamos la confesión;
es.B: Tenemos, entonces, un gran sumo sacerdote que ha pasado a través de los cielos: Jesús, el Hijo de Dios. Así que aferrémonos con firmeza a la confesión que hacemos.
es.R: Jesús, el Hijo de Dios, es nuestro gran sumo sacerdote. Él ha pasado a través de los cielos hasta la presencia de Dios. Así que sigamos aferrados con fuerza a la fe que confesamos.

fr.L: Ayant donc un grand prêtre éminent qui est passé à travers les cieux, Jésus le Fils de Dieu, tenons ferme la confession ;
fr.B: Ainsi, nous avons un grand prêtre éminent qui a franchi les cieux : Jésus, le Fils de Dieu. Tenons donc fermement la confession que nous faisons.
fr.R: Jésus, le Fils de Dieu, est notre grand prêtre éminent. Il a traversé les cieux jusqu’à la présence de Dieu. Alors gardons solidement la foi que nous proclamons.

sw.L: Basi, tukiwa na kuhani mkuu mwenye ukuu aliyepita katikati ya mbingu, Yesu Mwana wa Mungu, na tuushikilie ukiri;
sw.B: Basi, tuna kuhani mkuu mwenye ukuu aliyepita katikati ya mbingu: Yesu Mwana wa Mungu. Kwa hiyo na tuushike kwa uthabiti ukiri tunaoutamka.
sw.R: Yesu, Mwana wa Mungu, ndiye kuhani mkuu wetu, aliye mkuu kuliko wote. Amepita katikati ya mbingu na kuingia mbele za Mungu. Kwa hiyo na tuishikilie kwa nguvu imani tunayoikiri.

vi.L: Vậy, vì có một thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm lớn đã đi qua các tầng trời, là Đức Giê-xu, Con của Đức Chúa Trời, chúng ta hãy giữ vững lời tuyên xưng;
vi.B: Vậy, chúng ta có một thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm lớn đã đi qua các tầng trời, là Đức Giê-xu, Con của Đức Chúa Trời. Vì thế, chúng ta hãy giữ chặt niềm tin mà chúng ta tuyên xưng.
vi.R: Đức Giê-xu, Con của Đức Chúa Trời, là thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm lớn của chúng ta. Ngài đã đi qua các tầng trời vào trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời. Vậy chúng ta hãy giữ chặt đức tin mà chúng ta tuyên xưng.

ko.L: 그러므로 우리는 하늘들을 지나가신 위대한 대제사장, 곧 하나님의 아들 예수를 모시고 있으니, 고백을 굳게 붙잡읍시다.
ko.B: 그러므로 우리에게는 하늘을 지나가신 위대한 대제사장이 계십니다. 바로 하나님의 아들 예수이십니다. 그러니 우리가 고백하는 신앙을 굳게 붙잡읍시다.
ko.R: 하나님의 아들 예수께서는 우리의 위대한 대제사장이십니다. 그분은 하늘을 지나 하나님 앞으로 들어가셨습니다. 그러므로 우리가 고백하는 믿음을 꼭 붙잡읍시다.

decisions.choice: passed through the heavens: as the high priest passed into the inner sanctuary
decisions.reason: On the Day of Atonement the high priest passed through the tent into the inner room before God (Leviticus 16). Jesus has passed through the heavens into God's presence (9:24).

decisions.choice: a great high priest: above every other high priest
decisions.reason: "Great" sets Jesus above the high priests of Israel (7:26-28; 10:21).

decisions.choice: hold fast the confession: keep holding on to the faith we declare
decisions.reason: ὁμολογία is the open declaration of faith in Jesus (3:1; 10:23).

decisions.choice: Son, capitalized
decisions.reason: The title of Christ, as in 1:2 and 3:6.

decisions.choice: the faith we confess
decisions.reason: Readable's book-wide rendering of this word.

decisions.choice: into God's presence
decisions.reason: Readable says where Jesus has gone, as 9:24 does.

decisions.choice: confesión (L, B); la fe que confesamos (R)
decisions.reason: "Profesión" now means a person's trade. "Confesión" is what believers declare together (m3), and Readable says what it is, as the English Readable does. The same words are used in 3:1.

decisions.choice: kuhani mkuu mwenye ukuu (L, B); kuhani mkuu wetu, aliye mkuu kuliko wote (R)
decisions.reason: "kuhani mkuu" already means high priest, so "great" cannot simply be added as a second "mkuu" without sounding like a repetition. "mwenye ukuu" (who has greatness) keeps it a word of its own; Readable says what the greatness is, above every other high priest (m2).

decisions.choice: un grand prêtre éminent
decisions.reason: French "grand prêtre" already contains "grand", so "great" cannot be added as a second "grand". "éminent" says that he stands above the others (m2) without adding a title.

decisions.choice: "모시고 있다" (L); "계시다" (B) for having a high priest
decisions.reason: Korean "가지다" cannot be said respectfully of a person; as in the Korean 1 John 2:23, Literal says "모시다" and Balanced "우리에게 ... 계십니다".

source.text: οὐ γὰρ ἔχομεν ἀρχιερέα μὴ δυνάμενον συμπαθῆσαι ταῖς ἀσθενείαις ἡμῶν, πεπειρασμένον δὲ κατὰ πάντα καθ’ ὁμοιότητα χωρὶς ἁμαρτίας.

records.literal_gloss: Not for we have high priest not being able to sympathize with the weaknesses of us, having been tested but in all [respects] according to likeness, without sin.

en.L: For we have not a high priest unable to feel along with our weaknesses, but [one] who has been tested in all [ways] according to likeness, apart from sin.
en.B: For the high priest we have is not one who cannot share the feeling of our weaknesses; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has been put to the test in every way, as we are, but without sinning.
en.R: Our high priest understands our weaknesses and feels them with us. He was tested in every way that we are, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} never sinned.

es.L: Porque no tenemos un sumo sacerdote que no pueda sentir junto con nuestras debilidades, sino [uno] que ha sido probado en todo según [nuestra] semejanza, aparte del pecado.
es.B: Porque el sumo sacerdote que tenemos no es uno que no pueda compartir lo que sentimos en nuestras debilidades; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha sido puesto a prueba en todo, igual que nosotros, pero sin pecar.
es.R: Nuestro sumo sacerdote entiende nuestras debilidades y las siente con nosotros. Él fue puesto a prueba en todo, como nosotros, pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nunca pecó.

fr.L: Car nous n’avons pas de grand prêtre qui soit incapable de ressentir avec [nous] nos faiblesses, mais [un grand prêtre] mis à l’épreuve en toutes [choses] selon la ressemblance, en dehors du péché.
fr.B: Car le grand prêtre que nous avons n’est pas quelqu’un qui ne saurait partager ce que nous ressentons dans nos faiblesses ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a été mis à l’épreuve en tout, comme nous le sommes, mais sans pécher.
fr.R: Notre grand prêtre comprend nos faiblesses et les ressent avec nous. Il a été mis à l’épreuve de toutes les manières dont nous le sommes, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} n’a jamais péché.

sw.L: Kwa maana hatuna kuhani mkuu ambaye hawezi kuhisi pamoja nasi udhaifu wetu, bali [mmoja] aliyejaribiwa katika [mambo] yote kwa namna ile ile [kama sisi], bila dhambi.
sw.B: Kwa maana kuhani mkuu tuliye naye si mmoja asiyeweza kuguswa na udhaifu wetu; {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} amejaribiwa kwa kila namna, kama sisi tunavyojaribiwa, ila hakutenda dhambi.
sw.R: Kuhani mkuu wetu anauelewa udhaifu wetu na kuuhisi pamoja nasi. Alijaribiwa kwa kila namna tunavyojaribiwa sisi, lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hakutenda dhambi kamwe.

vi.L: Vì chúng ta không có một thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm không thể cảm thông với những sự yếu đuối của chúng ta, nhưng [có một Đấng] đã bị thử thách trong mọi sự giống như [chúng ta], nhưng không phạm tội.
vi.B: Vì thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm của chúng ta không phải là Đấng không thể cảm thông với những sự yếu đuối của chúng ta; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã bị thử thách trong mọi phương diện như chúng ta, nhưng không hề phạm tội.
vi.R: Thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm của chúng ta hiểu những yếu đuối của chúng ta và cùng cảm nhận với chúng ta. Ngài đã bị thử thách trong mọi phương diện như chúng ta, nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không bao giờ phạm tội.

ko.L: 우리에게 계신 대제사장은 우리의 연약함을 함께 느끼지 못하시는 분이 아니라, 모든 면에서 [우리와] 똑같이 시험을 받으셨으나 죄는 없으신 분입니다.
ko.B: 우리에게 계신 대제사장은 우리의 연약함을 함께 느끼지 못하시는 분이 아닙니다. 그분은 모든 면에서 우리처럼 시험을 받으셨지만, 죄를 짓지 않으셨습니다.
ko.R: 우리의 대제사장께서는 우리의 연약함을 이해하시고 우리와 함께 아파하십니다. 그분은 우리가 받는 모든 시험을 똑같이 받으셨지만, 한 번도 죄를 짓지 않으셨습니다.

decisions.choice: feel along with: share the feeling, suffer with
decisions.reason: συμπαθέω is more than pity; it is feeling with someone (the same verb in 10:34).

decisions.choice: tested: put to the test, including temptation to sin
decisions.reason: πειράζω covers trials and temptations alike; Jesus suffered when he was tested (2:18). "Tempted" is the familiar rendering; the word includes it.

decisions.choice: in every way, as we are
alternatives: in every way, because he was like us
decisions.reason: The phrase may mean "in the same way as we are" or "in keeping with his likeness to us"; both point to 2:17, that he was made like his brothers and sisters in every way.

decisions.choice: apart from sin: he was tested without sinning
alternatives: tested in everything except what comes from a sinful nature
decisions.reason: The main sense is that he never gave in (7:26). The phrase can also mean that his testing did not come from sin within him; either way he was without sin.

decisions.choice: the high priest we have is not one who cannot ...
alternatives: we do not have a high priest who cannot ...
decisions.reason: A positive frame for the double negative.

decisions.choice: probado; puesto a prueba
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the word as testing of every kind, temptation to sin included (m2). Spanish "tentado" now means only being tempted, so Spanish says "probado" and "puesto a prueba", the words used for the wilderness testing in 3:8-9.

decisions.choice: mis à l’épreuve
decisions.reason: The book-wide French for this verb, as in 2:18 and 3:9: it covers trials and temptation alike (m2), where "tenté" names only temptation to sin.

records.literal_gloss: Let us approach therefore with boldness the throne of the grace, so that we may receive mercy and grace we may find for well-timed help.

en.L: Let us therefore approach with boldness the throne of grace, so that we may receive mercy and may find grace for well-timed help.
en.B: So let us, with confidence, approach the throne of grace, to receive mercy and to find grace that brings help just when we need it.
en.R: So let us come near to God's throne, the place where grace is given. Let us come with confidence. There we will receive mercy, and we will find grace that helps us at the very moment we need it.

es.L: Acerquémonos, pues, con franqueza al trono de la gracia, para que recibamos misericordia y encontremos gracia para una ayuda a su tiempo.
es.B: Así pues, con confianza, acerquémonos al trono de la gracia, para recibir misericordia y hallar una gracia que nos ayude justo cuando hace falta.
es.R: Así que acerquémonos al trono de Dios, el lugar donde se da la gracia. Acerquémonos con confianza. Allí recibiremos misericordia, y encontraremos la gracia que nos ayuda en el momento mismo en que la necesitamos.

fr.L: Approchons-nous donc avec hardiesse du trône de la grâce, afin que nous recevions miséricorde et que nous trouvions grâce pour un secours au bon moment.
fr.B: Ainsi, approchons-nous en toute assurance du trône de la grâce, pour y recevoir miséricorde et y trouver la grâce qui nous secourt juste quand il le faut.
fr.R: Alors approchons-nous du trône de Dieu, là où la grâce est donnée. Venons avec assurance. Là, nous recevrons la miséricorde, et nous trouverons la grâce qui nous aide au moment précis où nous en avons besoin.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo tukaribie kwa ujasiri kiti cha enzi cha neema, ili tupokee rehema, na tupate neema kwa ajili ya msaada wa wakati ufaao.
sw.B: Basi tukaribie kiti cha enzi cha neema tukiwa na ujasiri, ili tupokee rehema na kupata neema inayotuletea msaada wakati ule ule tunapouhitaji.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo tukaribie kiti cha enzi cha Mungu, mahali ambapo neema hutolewa. Tukaribie tukiwa na ujasiri. Huko tutapokea rehema, na tutapata neema itakayotusaidia wakati hasa tunapoihitaji.

decisions.choice: approach: come near to God, as worshipers and priests do
decisions.reason: προσέρχομαι is used in the Greek Old Testament of priests and worshipers coming near to God; the letter uses it for believers (7:25; 10:22).

decisions.choice: the throne of grace: God's throne, from which grace is given
decisions.reason: The throne is God's; Jesus is seated at its right hand (8:1; 12:2). It is a throne marked by grace, where those who come receive help.

decisions.choice: with boldness: freely and openly, without fear
decisions.reason: παρρησία is the freedom of those who belong and may come in (3:6; 10:19).

decisions.choice: well-timed help: help that comes at the right moment
decisions.reason: εὔκαιρος means timely, coming when it is needed.

decisions.choice: confidence
decisions.reason: As in 3:6.

decisions.choice: come near
decisions.reason: Readable's book-wide rendering.

decisions.choice: God's throne, the place where grace is given
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase, as the meaning decision does.

decisions.choice: con franqueza (L); con confianza (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in 3:6, Literal keeps "franqueza", open and unafraid speech, and Balanced and Readable say "confianza" (m3). "Confiadamente" is avoided as the word of the familiar Spanish versions of this verse.

decisions.choice: kiti cha enzi (throne)
decisions.reason: "kiti" alone is any seat; "kiti cha enzi" is a king's throne. It also keeps God's throne distinct from "kiti cha rehema", the mercy seat of 9:5.

decisions.choice: approchons-nous; hardiesse (L), assurance (B, R)
decisions.reason: "s’approcher" is the book-wide French for coming near to God as worshipers (m1), at Readable too. The boldness is "hardiesse" at Literal and "assurance" at Balanced and Readable, as in 3:6.

decisions.choice: "đến gần" for approaching God (also 7:25; 10:1, 10:22; 11:6; 12:18-22); "ngai ân điển" (L, B), "ngai của Đức Chúa Trời, là nơi ban ân điển" (R)
decisions.reason: To approach is to come near to God as worshipers and priests do (m1), so the same plain verb is kept wherever Hebrews uses this word. "Ngai" is the word for a throne in the Vietnamese Gospels (Matthew 19:28; 23:22), and "ân điển" is the key term for grace.

decisions.choice: "나아가다" for approaching God, through the letter (7:25; 10:1, 22; 11:6; 12:18, 22); "은혜의 보좌"; "자비" for mercy
decisions.reason: To approach is to come near to God as worshipers and priests do (meaning decision); "나아가다" is the Korean word for coming before a king or God, kept for every use of the verb in the letter. "자비" is the current word for mercy, as in the Korean Matthew 9:13; "긍휼" is the older church word.
